title: Three Years and One Short Engine
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：hybrid　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hybrid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the researcher ① tested the hybrid that no mechanic in the garage would have described, and he said the testing was the whole of the year. The ② hybrid, meaning the mix itself and not the engine, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; hybrid, he said, is the only thing in a garage that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of hybrid in that garage had the same short engine beside it, and the ④ hybrid at the far hoist, meaning the model they kept for the children to study and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Hybrid, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hybrid was the whole of the matter, meaning the blend and not the mix. The ⑥ hybrid, meaning the blend and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hybrid, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both mix and a blend. He said the blend is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ hybrid had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short engine. The ⑧ hybrid of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in September, was one garage and three years of describing; hybrid, he said, is either the model at the far hoist or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hybrid I remember is the hybrid described in the list, which closed in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the garage. ⑩ Hybrid, my mother said in 1992, is the only thing that improves by being described; all hybrid, she said, is a blend that has agreed to look like mix. She said the blend was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 混合动力；混合物（指车间里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 混合动力；混合物（指那批混合动力机本身，与引擎相对）
C. 固定搭配：test the hybrid 测试这台混合动力机
D. n. 混合动力；混合物（指留给孩子们研究的那一款那一批）
E. n. 混动之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的混合动力之事）
F. n. 混合动力；混合物（指清单里写到、被记下的的那一批）
G. n. 融合、结合（指一件事里人人都造却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 结合（抽象总称，指人人都造却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tested the hybrid that no mechanic in the garage would have described
The hybrid, meaning the mix itself and not the engine
Every kind of hybrid in that garage
the hybrid at the far hoist
the hybrid was the whole of the matter
the hybrid had become a line in a list
The hybrid of the whole thing

answers.why: test the hybrid 意为“测试这台混合动力机”，1983 年那位研究员把车间里没有一位技师肯描述的一台混合动力机做了一遍。
hybrid 意为“混合动力；混合物”，指那批混合动力机本身而不是引擎，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被描述。
hybrid 意为“混合动力；混合物”，指车间里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一台小小的引擎。
hybrid 意为“混合动力；混合物”，指最远那台吊架留给孩子们研究的那一款那一批，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hybrid 意为“融合、结合”，指一件事里人人都造却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种融合就是那件事的全部。
hybrid 意为“结合”，指人人都造却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批混合动力机，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hybrid 意为“混合动力；混合物”，指清单里写到、被记下的的那一批，到 1988 年这一批成了清单里的一行。
hybrid 意为“混动之事”，研究员九月写道，整件事的混合动力之事是一处车间和三个年的描述。
hybrid 意为“混合动力；混合物”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那一批，1990 年发完了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一批。
hybrid 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，混合动力是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的混合动力机。
